description: Declared exclusions for the IN-PROCESS Rust FHIRPath R4 conformance suite (crates/fhirpath/tests/r4_tests.rs), read against the vendored corpus data/r4/tests-fhir-r4.xml. There is no .NET counterpart for R4 — the external validator job in .github/workflows/ci.yml is R5-only — so this file has no sibling to stay in sync with. Every entry is enforced: an entry matching no test fails the build, and an exact entry whose test starts passing fails the build with 'delete this entry'. See issue #307. The list is currently EMPTY and should stay that way unless a real limitation appears: the ten testQuantity entries this file shipped with were inherited from the in-body `quantity_tests_to_ignore` array and were already obsolete — UCUM conversion and calendar-duration comparison are implemented (crates/fhirpath/src/ucum.rs, octofhir-ucum), all eleven testQuantity tests pass, and the enforcement added in #307 is what surfaced it. NOTE: the R4 corpus contains two duplicate (group, test) name pairs (testObservations::testPolymorphismIsA and testLiterals::testLiteralString); an entry naming either would cover both tests.
